trends.name: Iran Conflict & Oil Market Volatility
trends.summary: Trump delayed strikes on Iranian power plants, causing oil to tumble to $100/barrel, but Chevron CEO warns impact isn't fully priced in. NATO vows to reopen Strait of Hormuz amid weeks of expected fighting with Iran and Hezbollah. Western oil infrastructure is now a direct target, creating supply-side uncertainty that could reverse recent price declines.

trends.name: Gold Bear Market & Asset Allocation Shift
trends.summary: Gold has officially entered bear market territory, down 22% from January 29th record high of $5,608. This major pullback signals a rotation in safe-haven demand and may reflect rising real rates and Trump-era inflation expectations. Bond yields rising ($AGG at 4.5% YTM) are attracting capital away from traditional precious metals hedges.

trends.name: Fed Policy Shift & Inflation Concerns
trends.summary: Fed's Austan Goolsbee expressed worry about inflation in a 'fraught but intense' climate, signaling potential shift in the Fed's rate-cut narrative. Rising bond yields ($AGG 4.5% YTM, 2-year at 3.91%) and market volatility suggest investors are repricing inflation expectations upward, constraining further rate cuts.

trends.name: Record Trading Volume & Market Confidence Rally
trends.summary: S&P 500 ETF ($SPY) trading volume surged to $1.4 billion on Friday—highest in 2026 and 5th-highest in 2.5 years. Volume spike preceded Trump's market-turning post, indicating explosive retail/institutional participation. This signals either capitulation buying or conviction in Trump's market-friendly policies.

trends.name: AI Chip Demand & Nvidia's Strategic Bets
trends.summary: Tesla/Musk's expensive chip-making plan tests investor faith, while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argues AI will create jobs, not eliminate them. However, coal outperforming Nvidia in 2026 signals potential energy/infrastructure concern and questions about AI monetization trajectory. Market reassessing whether AI capex boom translates to actual earnings growth.

trends.name: Energy Infrastructure & Diesel Supply Policy
trends.summary: Trump administration plans to increase diesel supply as fuel prices surge, addressing supply-side constraints. Eversource, Brookfield Infrastructure, and energy infrastructure plays gaining attention amid decade-high power demand. Policy shift toward domestic energy production favors infrastructure and utilities over renewables-only strategies.

trends.name: Trump's 'Trump Accounts' & Financial Asset Class
trends.summary: BlackRock's Larry Fink suggests Trump-branded accounts paired with other assets could be 'very significant' for young adults, signaling a new retail investment vehicle tied to Trump administration brand. This reflects broader market trust in Trump policies and opens new distribution channels for financial products.

trends.name: Healthcare Cost Crisis & Structural Inflation
trends.summary: Rising healthcare costs are forcing consumers to skip meals and make severe trade-offs, with conditions expected to worsen. This signals sticky inflation in healthcare sector and potential drag on consumer discretionary spending—a structural headwind for equities despite stock market rallies.

trends.name: XRP Settlement & Crypto Market Sentiment
trends.summary: XRP price holding near $1.44 as buyers test post-settlement ceiling, reflecting resolution of regulatory uncertainty. This marks potential inflection point for crypto risk-on sentiment and could signal broader risk appetite in digital assets as regulatory clarity emerges.

trends.name: Travel Stocks Surge on Iran De-escalation Hope
trends.summary: Travel stocks among biggest gainers as Trump teases Iran talks and Polymarket trader who predicted war start now bets on cease-fire by next week. Airlines, hotels, and tourism plays rallying on expectations of reduced geopolitical risk premium and return to normal demand.

trends.name: Salesforce AI Opportunity & Enterprise Software Pivot
trends.summary: Salesforce's perceived 'AI Problem' reframed as greatest opportunity, signaling market repricing of enterprise software leaders positioned for AI monetization. CRM platform integration with generative AI could unlock significant revenue upside if execution succeeds.

trends.name: European Political Shift & Market Implications
trends.summary: French election shows Socialists securing Paris while Le Pen's populists make historic local gains, reflecting broader European rightward political shift. This mirrors Trump-era nationalism globally and may drive currency volatility (EUR weakness), trade policy uncertainty, and rotation toward nationalist-friendly sectors.
